name: Drinks & Liquids
description: Shaken, not... spilled? Adds puddles to several thrown items. Water and wine (electricity), alcohol (flammable) and soda (slippery).

options.name: Water
options.tooltip: Water pools from Atlantide bottle, martini shaker, and snow globe

options.name: Alcohol
options.tooltip: Makes vodka and whiskey bottles spill flammable alcohol

options.name: Alcohol (Quest items)
options.tooltip: Makes quest item vodka bottles throwable and create flammable puddles. Slightly bugged still - the bottles will become invisible when placed with their quest prompts, but still function for the quest poisonings.

options.name: Wine
options.tooltip: Throwing wine bottles creates pools of wine that can electrocute like water

options.name: Soda
options.tooltip: Throwing soda cans creates slippery puddles of soda

options.name: NPC Drinks
options.tooltip: When NPCs drop their drinks, they will create slippery puddles. Made more NPCs drop drinks instead of teleporting them back to starting positions. Let me know if you find any NPCs doing magic drink teleporting and I'll try to patch them.

options.name: Overpowered Water Canister
options.tooltip: So it's not a usless item with all the liquid throwables, this makes the water canister MUCH stronger. Experiment and find out :) (try shooting it)

options.name: Overpowered Oil Canister (WIP)
options.tooltip: Work in progress, makes the oil canister far more powerful by [REDACTED]. May cause occasional crashes which is why it's still marked as WIP, let me know if you experience any.

options.name: BONUS | Champagne Glass
options.tooltip: Adds a champagne glass melee weapon that creates slippery puddle when broken. Adds it to the safehouse as well.

options.name: BONUS | Whiskey Glass
options.tooltip: Adds a new whiskey glass melee item, which creates a slippery puddle when broken. Adds a whiskey glass to the safehouse as well.

options.name: BONUS | Beer Bottle
options.tooltip: Adds a throwable beer bottle melee weapon that creates a slippery puddle when it breaks.
